import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0081 (a b : List Nat) : (a ++ b).length = a.length + b.length := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0081 (a b : List Nat) : (a ++ b).length = a.length + b.length := by
  induction a with
  | nil => by
    simp [List.length, List.append]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    induction b with
    | nil => by
      simp [List.length, List.append]
    | cons y ys =>
      simp [List.length, List.append, ih]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0081 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0081 := by

#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0081
